notes.title: Meowtiplayer
notes.content:
[h2][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h2][p]Today, we are releasing the [b]Coop Meowtiplayer Update[/b] for Bongo Cat! [/p][p]You can now Bongo away [b]together[/b] with [b]up to 100 friends[/b] while you work, study, or game. [/p][p]Everything is handled by Steam, so no servers, or other stuff you need to connect to. Just a seamless Steam integration. [/p][p]
Check out this cool trailer!![/p][previewyoutube="U191XLPQAXs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Fruit Fusion Sets[/b] [/h2][p]When you are in a [b]multiplayer session[/b] with [b]at least one other player[/b], you will receive a pop-up after a while. In this pop-up, you have to choose whether you are [b]team[/b] [b]Strawberry[/b], [b]Pineapple[/b], or [b]Watermelon[/b]. 

These item sets can only be obtained by playing multiplayer, and you can [b]only drop one of the item sets.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45392114/b4e370e650e972ddadabab63c020117f8a9ceaaa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New supporter items: the GODS[/b][/h2][p]This contains 3 skins and 3 hats. Poseidon, Zeus and Hades! 
This helps us to support the ongoing development and cosmetics creation, we want to Bongo as long as possible![/p][p]Get them each, or get the [b]33% discount[/b] if you grab all them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45392114/2fffd5f0dfb086e7ba68b4662364a484a5b768c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929900/Bongo_Cat__God_Pack"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929900/Bongo_Cat__God_Pack"][/dynamiclink][url="https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/3419430/detail/23/" style="button"]God Pack Store[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Since we had to make some changes to how we manage the game window, it is no longer possible to move Bongo Cat from one screen to another by just dragging. Instead, there is now an option in the settings to switch the screen on which Bongo Cat is running. You can hit [b]F8[/b] as a shortcut to switch the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]With this update, we are introducing [b]on-demand rendering[/b]. This can drastically improve GPU performance when running Bongo Cat. If you want to use this, just disable the “Bobbing” feature in the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The cat and UI are now scaled separately from each other[/p][/*][*][p]We finally cleaned up our settings and grouped them into categories for easier navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]We added a settings option that allows you to [b]delete items from the game[/b]. Be careful with this one, as the deleted items can not be recovered.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: QoL, Bug Fixes and Trading Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

WHAT A LAUNCH, thanks to everyone playing! I love to read all your messages in the morning <3

Over 150.000 people played the game already, that is INSANE!!!

[b]I now gathered multiple issues and changed a few things:
[/b][list]
[*]Fixes a bug that screen boundaries are ignored and your mouse could move to another screen
[*]Fixes that your game tabs out if you hover over the cat in a fullscreen game
[*]Adds the "Admin Mode" you need to opt-in this will make Bongo Cat start as admin, which solves a lot of issues regarding clicks not getting tracked in several games!
[*]Adds a quit button, yeah i know, long overdue, but why would you quit Bongo Cat :(
[/list]

[b]And now to one of the more controversial changes: i just removed trading between two users (NOT THE MARKET, THIS STILL WORKS). I noticed bot accounts farming thousands of items and by moving the items to one single account and then selling a ton of them in bulk. To prevent this i now removed trading between two users this will make their lifes harder (i hope).[/b]
This doesn't mean that this is permanent but i want to ensure that everybody has a good time, if i can handle the bots then i will try to bring this back <3 Thanks for your understanding!


If you read this: the gaming mode disables all interactions until a chest is ready, i added this so you can focus on your game and still collect the rewards and not accidently clicking on things. Hope this clarifies a few things.

[b]A small list of things i will add soon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support is still WIP, it's way harder than i anticipated so please stay tuned <3
[*] Sounds (but opt-in)
[*] New items
[*] Fixing the annoying red cross, i finally know the reason: the moment Steam detects you as "away" it will mess with the item drops...already talking to them to see if this can be fixed and how :)
[*] And all the bugs that come up
[/list]

[b]And regarding the special demo items (if you are eligable you can still do this for a few more days, then the demo will become unavailable, so be quick!):[/b]
1. Restart Steam
2. Reinstall the demo (the small Download demo button on main store page)
3. Start the Demo
4. Start the full game

Best
Your pigeon gruu gruu <3

notes.title: Bongo Cat is out meow!!!
notes.content:
The full version of the game is finally here! Thanks everyone for testing and playing the demo, i really didn't expect so many people to play it and enjoy what i made <3 [b]Thank you all![/b]

[b]What does this mean?[/b]
[list]
[*] It is time to get the full game for free!
[*] You will lose all your demo items, but get two exclusive legendary hats for playing the demo
(if you have 30mins of playtime in the demo). I have to do this unfortunately because Steam doesn't allow me to transfer the items between the demo and the full game.

[*] More skins!!! (also multiple color variants) and a few more hats :)
[*] You can now mark your favorite hats (click the star in the corner of an item)
[*] For those who like to type, you can now ignore mouse clicks
[*] I removed the tray icon (i hope i can bring it back soon) because some people had issues with this, sorry!
[*] Lots of bug fixes (you can't scale the window out of your screen, it will limit the scale now)
[/list]
Have fun with the full game!
If you have more suggestions or questions, just join the [url=https://discord.gg/zNdFA4qD5k]Discord[/url].
